_comment: Canonical Meshtastic bearer wire contract, shared by bearers/apple/HopBearerMeshtastic
dial-backoff table, this exists because bearers are per-platform packages with no shared core: the
two Meshtastic implementations must agree byte for byte or an Apple phone and an Android phone on
the same LoRa mesh cannot talk. tools/meshtastic-parity.sh fails CI if either side drifts from
hop_portnum: the Meshtastic PortNum Hop rides, inside the PRIVATE_APP range (256..511).
max_chunk / frag_header: a Hop link frame is split into fragments of at most max_chunk bytes, each
prefixed with a frag_header of [msgId:2][fragIndex:1][fragCount:1]. These two numbers ARE the
fragmentation contract; fragment_vectors pins the resulting fragment count for a set of frame
sizes so a change to max_chunk that silently reshapes the wire is caught.
frames: the 1-byte Hop link-frame type tags, identical to the LAN bearer (hello/ping/pong/data).
ping_ms / dead_ms: the keepalive cadence and liveness deadline (Swift declares seconds, Kotlin
declares milliseconds; the guard scales before comparing so a seconds/millis mixup cannot pass).
